answer.summary: This procedure loads account records from a source file into an internal memory table, validates each record for integrity, and writes the valid records to an output file. It also provides a lookup mechanism to find the index of a specific account number within the loaded table.
inputs: ACCTFILE: Input file containing account records (CHAR 140)
outputs: ACCTOUT: Output file containing the loaded and validated account records (CHAR 140)

rules.text: Initialize error counter and end-of-file flag.
Read all records from ACCTFILE into the internal table KTAB_SATZ until EOF.
If the internal table reaches its maximum bound, trigger an error via KBU00011.
Increment the record counter KTAB_ANZ for every record read.
Validate each record using KBU00022 and accumulate the error count in K@FEHL.
Log the total number of loaded records.
If any validation errors were found (K@FEHL > 0), log the error count and terminate the procedure.
Lookup function (KBU00013): Search for the first occurrence where the first 11 characters of a table record match the input account number (K@NR).
Write all loaded records from the internal table to ACCTOUT in the same order they were read.
Log the total number of records written to the output file.
